text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Oguri Cap.
To help overcome her weakness, I suggested helping out
at a shop with customer service, and—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a regional specialty shop, huh...?
They sell souvenirs from all sorts of areas.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There are souvenirs from my hometown too...
It brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text: Are you the girl who's here to help out at the shop?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Right. I intend to give it my all.

Having finished her preparations, Oguri Cap headed over to her assigned booth.
Her eyes were brimming with determination.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Trainer. Working as a clerk
will give me more chances to interact with peers my age.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have no experience with customer service...
Will I really be alright?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: True, if you think of it as talking to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, this should work.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
What should I buy~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Food would be nice, if possible...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me, customer...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for food, I recommend the daifuku
packed with plenty of fruit.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The combination of the sweet and tart fruit with the
rich sweetness of the cream and bean paste is simply wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it is delicious. I had some earlier,
and I was quite surprised by how sweet it was.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...And maybe horseshoe-shaped cookies.
Eating them before a race gives you a surge of power.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The race... Huh, come to think of it, clerk,
haven't I seen you somewhere before...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Could you possibly be...
Ms. Oguri Cap!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No way!
I actually went to watch your last race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You're working a part-time job too, huh...
Do your best, I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I intend to give my all in both.
Please let me know if there is anything else you are curious about.
Even after that, Oguri Cap seemed to serve the customers with confidence and poise.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Carrots, huh...
Carrots... Carrots...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...The customer is a carrot...
—Alright, got it."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Why does this doll
have so many different color variants?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I wanna know too~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The profit margin on these dolls varies depending on the color.
For instance, the carrot one—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Carrots?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It is said to offer benefits such as being able to eat lots of carrots, among other things...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You get to eat big carrots... and soft carrots too...
*drools*

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"No, I don't really get it, but...
I suddenly got a shiver down my spine..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If there are any other car—colors catching your eye,
just let me know. I'll eat—rush over right away!
Even after that, Oguri Cap continued to attend to the customers with ravenous enthusiasm.
